summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved lists not persisting  ### What I checked first (read-only, no edits) I traced the whole chain before proposing anything: - `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` — has its own auth check (cookie → session lookup → inject user id), and every route (list/create/read/update/delete/add-item/remove-item) filters by that user's id. This matches the pattern used for portfolio. - `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx` — fetches via a shared `api` helper that sends cookies (`credentials: "include"`); no localStorage/sessionStorage fallback anywhere in the watchlist code pat
